[[File:Iron battleaxe detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''iron battleaxe''' is the second-weakest [[battleaxe]] in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', being more powerful than the [[bronze battleaxe]]. Like all [[iron weapons]], it can be wielded at level 1 [[Attack]].

Players can make an iron battleaxe with level 25 [[Smithing]] using three [[iron bar]]s, giving 75 experience. It is a [[slashing weapon]], which makes it good for monsters with a slash weakness. Players can purchase this battleaxe from [[Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar]] in [[Port Sarim]] and [[Bob's Brilliant Axes]] shop in [[Lumbridge]].
